test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Her hopes for building her own __house were beaten when__ she lost her jewellery box.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**house were dashed when**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Beaten**" here means "defeated" or "crushed".
